meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'мный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('clever, smart').

examples.text: Ты же у нас такая умная!
Ты же у нас такая умная! Скажи, что сделать, я сделаю.
examples.trans: You're the clever one here! Tell me what to do, and I'll do it.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('beautiful, handsome').

examples.trans: They have a very beautiful house.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: almost always the short form: я согласен (man), я согласна (woman)
+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

examples.text: Был неправ. Простите. Я хочу закончить начатое.
examples.trans: I was wrong. Forgive me. I want to finish what I started.

meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'ниверситет'). Common masculine noun meaning 'university' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Да какие возможности? У меня университет!
examples.trans: What possibilities? I run a university!
The student carefully studies the new rule.
Really? I am studying the original design.
Is he carefully studying our hall?

meanings.note: a regional office of a government service

examples.trans: He works at the main directorate.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
They called from the Italian restaurant.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('prestigious').

examples.trans: This is a very prestigious education.

examples.text: Это слово «престижный» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'prestigious' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'разование'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'education' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Кто тебе денег дал на образование?
examples.trans: Who gave you money for your education?
She has a good university education.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: Core Russian adv meaning 'then, later, afterwards' in everyday speech.
работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: Modern borrowing from English 'manager' (ultimately from Italian 'maneggiare', to handle, from Latin 'manus', hand).

examples.text: Это слово «менеджер» часто звучит в разговоре.
examples.trans: This word 'manager' is often heard in conversation.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: Qualitative adjective formed with the productive suffix '-тельный'/'-ливый'. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('talented, gifted').

examples.trans: He is a very talented young cook.

examples.text: В нашем ресторане работают талантливые люди.
examples.trans: Talented people work in our restaurant.
He was the most talented cook.

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!
